surface: Claude Code terminal mod: AbovePrompt band, toasts, Panes /plan /agents /runner, short bottom bar
style: Minimalism & Swiss, dense (ui-ux-pro-max design system, density 9, motion 2, variance 2)
type: the user's terminal font; no face is chosen. Hierarchy from weight (bold), dim and case only

color.source: Claude Code ThemeKeys only, never hex, so the mod follows the user's light or dark terminal theme
color.hue_decision: OCCUPY the host's own accent: the `claude` key marks wf-dash's identity chip and hotkey letters, so the mod reads as part of Claude Code, not a guest
color.rule: colour is never the only signal: every state also prints its word, every meter its number

craft_moves: one accent, spent on identity and hotkeys only
labels dim, values plain: k9s label/value
numbers right aligned in fixed width so a tick never shifts the line
pane title and [count] set into the top border
key hints as <key> Action at the pane foot
rejected: powerline chevrons on coloured backgrounds; hex palettes; emoji status icons
